# AQT and QIT Solutions

#  Quantum Information Theory (QIT) & Advanced Quantum Theory (AQT) Solutions

This repository contains **full solutions** for Advanced Quantum Theory (AQT) and Quantum Information Theory (QIT) exercises solutions WS_2025.  

> ⚠️ Due to university privacy policies, problem statements are **not included** in this repository.  

## About the Course 
- Quantum computing  
- Quantum communication  

## Topics Covered for  Quantum Information Theory (QIT) Solutions Winter Semester 2025 

### Introduction
- Dirac formalism, linear operators, unitary evolution  

### Quantum Measurement
- Projective & POVM measurements  
- CHSH inequality  

### Quantum Information
- No-cloning theorem  
- Quantum teleportation
- Entanglement Swapping 
- Superdense coding  

### Quantum Operations
- Operator-sum representation  
- Kraus representation  

### Distance Measures
- Trace distance  
- Fidelity  
- Influence of quantum operations  

### Entropy & Information
- Shannon entropy  
- Von Neumann entropy  
- Holevo bound  

### Entanglement Theory*
- Schmidt decomposition  
- LOCC and separable operations  
- Entanglement monotones & measures  
- Positive partial transpose and negativity  

### Quantum Error Correction*
- Introduction to error correction methods
- bit-flip channel
- phase-flip channel
- syndrome extraction
- bit-flip 3-qubit code
- phase-flip 3-qubit code
- Shor 9-qubit code

## Topics Covered for Advanced Quantum Theory (AQT) Solutions Winter Semester 2025 – 126325 

Quantum mechanics has revolutionized our understanding of the physical world in the 20th century.  More recently, technologies exploiting the properties of individual quantum particles—such as superposition and entanglement—are being explored for applications like quantum computing and simulations.

- fundamental of quantum mechanics  
- Density operator  
- Entanglement  
- Quantum channels  
- Quantum measurement  
- Basics of light–matter interactions
